company.shortDescription: Intuit provides financial software solutions to empower individuals and businesses.
company.description: Intuit offers a suite of financial software products, including TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp, designed to enhance financial confidence for individuals and businesses. The company serves approximately 100 million customers globally, helping them save time and make informed financial decisions. Intuit is committed to driving economic opportunity and prosperity, particularly for underserved communities.
